name: LeaseSmart
install: npm --prefix _qa install && npm --prefix tgt-website install && { [ -f config.js ] || cp config.example.js config.js; }

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Static file server for the LeaseSmart single-page app (index.html + _data seeds). Open http://localhost:8080/ — runs in demo/sandbox mode without Supabase credentials.

terminals.name: tgt-website
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the tgt-website conversion homepage, including the local-mock /api/intake endpoint (X-TGT-Intake-Mode: local-mock-no-smtp, never live SMTP). Open http://localhost:5173/.
